definition.def: To detect something means to find it or discover that it is present somewhere by using equipment or making an investigation.
examples: ...a sensitive piece of equipment used to detect radiation. [VERB noun]
Most skin cancers can be cured if detected and treated early. [VERB noun]
...a device which can detect who is more at risk of a heart attack. [VERB wh]

definition.def: If you detect something, you notice it or sense it, even though it is not very obvious.
examples: Arnold could detect a certain sadness in the old man's face. [VERB noun]
